title: Actions Related to SRS for Positioning at Cell Re-selection in RRC_INACTIVE

entities.name: Cell Reselection with SRS Positioning Configuration
entities.description: Condition where cell reselection occurs while srs-PosRRC-InactiveConfig is configured in the UE.

entities.name: srs-PosRRC-InactiveConfig
entities.description: Configuration for SRS (Sounding Reference Signal) for Positioning in RRC_INACTIVE state.

entities.name: Timing Advance for SRS Positioning Transmission
entities.description: Timing Advance value used for SRS for Positioning transmission.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE
entities.description: RRC state where the UE is inactive but maintains some context.

relations.description: Cell reselection with srs-PosRRC-InactiveConfig configured causes the UE to consider the Timing Advance value for SRS for Positioning transmission as invalid.
Cell reselection with srs-PosRRC-InactiveConfig configured causes the UE to release the srs-PosRRC-InactiveConfig.
The actions for SRS for Positioning at cell reselection apply when the UE is in RRC_INACTIVE state.
